$comment: Enforcer-wiring manifest (task 011, DR-5/DR-8). One entry per
check-enforcer-wiring.mjs gate verifies each claim by TRANSITIVELY walking
npm-script chains + workflow run-steps and inspecting per-term exit-code
handling. It models four trap classes a name-grep cannot see:
1 orphan               — no workflow references it at all.
2 unreachable-npm      — referenced only from an npm script no workflow runs.
3 exit-code-swallowed  — runs in CI but `|| true` / continue-on-error eats its exit.
4 missing-synchronize  — a diff-dependent gate whose host workflow can't re-run on a push.
gating   — MUST be reachable-AND-failable from `workflow`; if `diffDependent`,
that workflow's pull_request trigger MUST include `synchronize`.
advisory — intentionally non-blocking (neutered / continue-on-error). MUST still
be reachable from some workflow, and MUST carry a rationale.
retired  — deliberately dead. MUST NOT be reachable-and-failable from any workflow,
and MUST carry a rationale. The file itself is typically deleted.

primaries.rationale: grep-gates step: BEGIN IMMEDIATE substrate-only layering gate (#1342 P1.E).

Runs in benchmark-gate.yml under `continue-on-error: true` by design — perf variance is noisy, so a regression is reported but does not block the merge. Reachable-but-non-failable is intentional, not a defect.

test-mcp step (DR-5), BLOCKING (task 009): `node scripts/check-coverage-ratchet.mjs` (no `--observe`) now fails the job on a coverage regression beyond its floored epsilon. The live coverage baseline (tools/audit/coverage-baseline.json — totals + run-ids + measured spread from 3 green CI runs on this feature branch: 29622454248, 29623082084, 29624088763) was captured and the observe flag dropped in the same change. Its scripts/ self-test (check-coverage-ratchet.test.sh) re-asserts unfiltered in grep-gates (DR-10).

Debloat wave-1 (task 011): design/plan collapsed into a single docs/specs doc (#1581); the standalone design-completeness enforcer no longer maps to a live phase artifact and was never wired into any workflow. Retired and file deleted.
This gate itself (task 011): a grep-gates step on the unfiltered host, so it fires on every PR and fails CI whenever a primary drifts from its manifest disposition.
grep-gates step: event-store access only via the composition root (#1342).

Wired into pr-body-check.yml (task 011): asserts a GOLDEN-FIXTURE-UPDATE marker when a load-bearing fixture changes (DR-15). It reads the PR diff, so its host workflow MUST re-run on `synchronize` or a fixture pushed after open leaves a stale green.
Unfiltered zero-dependency census: exact typed owners cover every production gate emitter, provider registration, playbook observation, and v3.0-reserved custom-shell transition guard.

grep-gates deps-tail step (task 054, DR-27): every annotated numeric claim in docs/specs/2026-08-06-internal-mechanics-overhaul.md is re-derived from the artifact that produces it (outputSchema census, EventTypes array, counted source scans) and a disagreement fails CI — the document cannot assert a number nothing produces. Rides the tsx-backed tail, not the zero-dep prefix, because the vacuity census must read the Zod schema OBJECT (a named binding launders a source-text grep). Deliberately NOT diffDependent and deliberately unfiltered: premises go stale when the CODE moves, which is exactly the PR a docs-path filter would skip. Also reachable via `npm run validate`; the ci.yml step is the failable path. Its self-test (check-measured-premises.test.ts, including the rev-3 kill fixture) re-asserts on the same host per DR-24.

grep-gates step (task 013): every dead-in-prod module must declare intent — a RESERVED(issue, owner, expires) header with a future expiry, or a declared allowlist class (DR-7). Fails closed on a reachability-scan crash (DR-8). Scans the whole tree (not a PR diff), so not diffDependent.

test-mcp step (DR-7), OBSERVE MODE, pull_request events only: `node scripts/check-mutation-gate.mjs --observe` logs the diff-scoped mutation-adequacy verdict and always exits 0 during the CI soak window. DEFERRED (task 009 scope change, #1720): the flip to `gating` does NOT land alongside the coverage ratchet's flip — the diff-scoped mutation gate degrades in CI because StrykerJS dry-run fails on the full server suite. Stays advisory/observe until #1720 resolves; that issue is this entry's exit condition. Advisory disposition MATCHES the actual non-blocking state per the manifest honesty contract; its scripts/ self-test (check-mutation-gate.test.sh) re-asserts unfiltered in grep-gates (DR-10).
grep-gates step: no raw .state.json read/write in production (#1504).

Wired into grep-gates (task 011). Previously reachable ONLY via `npm run validate`, which no workflow invokes (class-2 unreachable): a real prefix-fingerprint drift (DR-12) would have passed CI. Now a failable grep-gates step on every PR.

Debloat wave-1 (task 011): the fast-check property-test convention it enforced is now carried by the co-located vitest suites themselves; the standalone shell enforcer was never wired into any workflow and duplicated coverage. Retired and file deleted.

grep-gates step: migrateEvents at the read seam (#1556).
grep-gates step: one canonical workflow-state reducer (#1554).

grep-gates zero-dep-prefix step (DR-9): per-file `as unknown as` count-budget register, BLOCKING from merge day one. Scans the whole src tree (not a PR diff), so not diffDependent. Its scripts/ self-test (check-type-debt.test.sh) also re-asserts unfiltered in grep-gates (DR-10).
grep-gates step: Windows-portability anti-patterns (#1623).
grep-gates step: withSession idempotency contract (#1342 P1.D).
grep-gates step: WLM DR-1 retry adapter + DR-2 skills reroute (task-004).

grep-gates deps-tail step (#1706 DR-2, task 002): the error-envelope lint (`eslint --config eslint.envelopes.config.js` over servers/exarchos-mcp/src/orchestrate/**) runs on the UNFILTERED grep-gates lane, never the filtered test-root lint:windows step, so a registered MCP handler that lets a throw abnormally complete it (discarding a meaningful error.code) fails CI on every PR. Scans the whole orchestrate/** tree, not a PR diff, so not diffDependent.

Advisory by design (class-3 neutered instance): `skills:guard` runs `(npm run lint:inv6 || true)`, so lint-inv6 executes on every PR (via test-root `npm run skills:guard`) and prints its INV-6 findings, but its exit code is deliberately swallowed so it cannot fail CI. The `|| true` is intentional and documented in lint-inv6.mjs itself.

Correctly wired and LEFT ALONE (task 011): the same `skills:guard` line chains it with `&&` (`... && npm run lint:test-first-drift`), so its exit code propagates and it CAN fail CI via test-root `npm run skills:guard`.
